interpretation: The actual task was routed in two stages. The public retrieval stage selects both provider adapters because the task requires outputs from both; its host allowlist is limited to api.crossref.org and api.openalex.org. The local comparison stage selects only the comparator after those outputs exist. Default light routing leaves each stage incomplete, while adding PubMed/context candidates does not change selected tools. Both route plans remain proposals with execution_authorized=false; public calls were separately made through explicit CLI flags.
